node: HBM and advanced-packaging inputs below the memory producers
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around HBM and advanced-packaging inputs with a two-lane funnel. Reference anchors remain the HBM producers, TSMC/CoWoS, and AI accelerator vendors, but this pass prioritizes less obvious public suppliers below them: OSAT/advanced packaging capacity, inspection/metrology, HBM probe cards, and thermo-compression bonding tools. The most relevant US-listed underfollowed lane names found in this pass are AMKR, CAMT, FORM, and KLIC. The evidence is strongest for direct advanced-packaging/HBM linkage at FORM and CAMT; AMKR is more visible but still a key US-listed advanced-packaging capacity node; KLIC is a narrower equipment hypothesis tied to fluxless thermo-compression bonding and first HBM-system shipments.
